description: Metadata-only admission policy for local models. Defines provider types (ollama, local_hf, executable_adapter, no_model), capability and task-class declarations, and the rules under which a candidate may *eventually* be admitted live. This rung admits metadata only; no model is called, no subprocess runs, no network is consulted. Even the LOCAL_MODEL_METADATA_ADMITTED decision sets execution_authorized=False — live execution requires a separate, later admission step.
purpose: Rung 8 of the verified-repair campaign. Closes the policy-shape gap for the BLOCKED_NO_LIVE_MODEL_CALL reason in CORPUS_ELIGIBILITY_REPAIR_TRACE_GUARD_LOCK_001 — by spelling out exactly what a candidate would have to declare to be admissible, without yet doing the admission. The metadata-only admission is a precursor: a future LOCAL_MODEL_LIVE_ADMISSION rung would consume METADATA_ADMITTED decisions and attempt a probe.
admission_checks: provider is a known ModelProvider enum value
at least one capability_tag declared (NO_MODEL provider exempt)
supported_task_classes overlaps with allowed_task_classes (NO_MODEL provider exempt)
invariants: LocalModelAdmissionPolicy.evaluate is a pure function — no I/O.
Even LOCAL_MODEL_METADATA_ADMITTED keeps execution_authorized=False and training_eligible=False.
Stale model_id (CURRENT vs STALE set from MODEL_ROUTER_LOCK_001) blocks with LOCAL_MODEL_BLOCKED_STALE_ID.
requires_network=True blocks under default policy with LOCAL_MODEL_BLOCKED_NETWORK_MODEL; only allow_network_models=True opens it.
Unverified id (not in CURRENT_MODEL_IDS) blocks under default policy with LOCAL_MODEL_BLOCKED_UNVERIFIED_ID; only allow_unverified_ids=True opens it.
Missing capability_tags blocks with LOCAL_MODEL_BLOCKED_MISSING_CAPABILITIES (except for NO_MODEL provider).
Empty intersection with allowed_task_classes blocks with LOCAL_MODEL_BLOCKED_UNSUPPORTED_TASK_CLASS (except NO_MODEL).
NO_MODEL provider bypasses capability + task-class requirements — admits cleanly.
scripts/models/local_model_admission_*.py contains no `import subprocess`, no `import urllib`, no `import socket`, no `import http`.
Audit counts: BLOCKED_UNSAFE=0, MUST_MIGRATE=0, UNKNOWN=0, PROGRAMBENCH>=56.
remaining_gaps: Metadata-only admission. Live admission (actually probing the provider, validating capabilities, opening execution_authorized) requires a follow-up LOCAL_MODEL_LIVE_ADMISSION rung.
Provider 'executable_adapter' is enumerated but no concrete adapter contract is defined yet; future rungs may add capability schemas per provider.
Capability tags are free strings today — a future rung may pin them to a closed set (code_generation / diagnosis / planning / review / summary).
